cases.decision: inexact SQLite DECIMAL float storage and missing NOT NULL on currency
checks: Identifies that SQLite DECIMAL(12, 2) uses NUMERIC affinity and stores fractional monetary values as IEEE-754 REAL floats
Proposes scaled INTEGER minor units and NOT NULL currency with a valid SQLite schema sketch

cases.decision: strict SQLite integer-cents schema with constraints and outside-tx pragmas is clean
checks: Reports no finding against the STRICT integer-cents schema and connection-open PRAGMA setup

cases.decision: blocking PostgreSQL 16 SET NOT NULL and non-concurrent CREATE INDEX without lock_timeout
checks: Traces ACCESS EXCLUSIVE table scan on ALTER COLUMN external_ref SET NOT NULL and write lock on CREATE INDEX on a live 12M-row PG 16 table
Proposes PG 16 lock-safe NOT VALID CHECK plus VALIDATE CONSTRAINT in separate transactions with SET LOCAL lock_timeout, and CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY outside a transaction block

cases.decision: PG 16 lock-safe separate-transaction NOT VALID check validation and non-transactional CONCURRENTLY index build is clean
checks: Reports no migration lock finding when NOT VALID, VALIDATE CONSTRAINT, and SET NOT NULL run in separate transactions with SET LOCAL lock_timeout and CONCURRENTLY runs under atlas:txmode none

cases.decision: MySQL NOT IN nullable subquery returning zero rows and non-deterministic LIMIT without ORDER BY
checks: Traces three-valued NULL logic where nullable voided_invoices.invoice_id makes NOT IN return zero rows
Flags non-deterministic LIMIT 50 without ORDER BY and proposes NOT EXISTS with deterministic tie-breaking ORDER BY

cases.decision: MySQL NOT EXISTS with deterministic tie-breaker ORDER BY is clean
checks: Reports no query bug and does not falsely flag NOT EXISTS as an O(N*M) correlated subquery on MySQL 8.0.36

cases.decision: PostgreSQL check-then-act lost update and transaction held open across external HTTP fraud check
checks: Traces concurrent read-modify-write lost update on wallets.balance_cents under default READ COMMITTED without row lock or atomic update
Traces open DB transaction held across outbound risk.Check HTTP call and proposes running the risk check before an atomic conditional UPDATE that preserves missing-wallet vs insufficient-funds errors

cases.decision: outbound HTTP check outside transaction followed by atomic conditional UPDATE preserving error semantics is clean
checks: Reports no race, long-held transaction, or error-misclassification finding on the atomic conditional UPDATE with pre-call risk check

cases.decision: non-sargable DATE_TRUNC wrapping indexed created_at column on 50M-row table
checks: Traces that DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at, 'UTC') = $1::timestamptz prevents using idx_events_created_at_id on the documented 50M-row table
Proposes a sargable half-open range predicate on created_at preserving UTC day-bucket semantics

cases.decision: sargable half-open range predicate aligned with (created_at, id) index is clean
checks: Reports no indexing finding and does not falsely flag backwards scan on (created_at, id)

cases.decision: SQL string interpolation of status and dynamic ORDER BY plus N+1 query loop
checks: Identifies SQL injection via interpolated status and unallowlisted sortColumn identifier in listOrdersByStatus
Identifies N+1 per-id query loop in loadOrdersByIds and proposes bound parameters, closed allowlist, and batched ANY($1::bigint[])

cases.decision: parameterized query with closed sort allowlist and batched ANY lookup is clean
checks: Reports no SQL injection or N+1 finding when values are bound, sort keys pass a closed allowlist, and IDs are fetched in one batched query
